final_sql:
SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName FROM countries c JOIN car_makers m ON m.Country = c.CountryId GROUP BY c.CountryId, c.CountryName HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
UNION
SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName FROM countries c JOIN car_makers m ON m.Country = c.CountryId JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = m.Id WHERE ml.Model = 'fiat'
LIMIT 50
answer:
Four countries either have more than 3 car makers or produce a fiat model:

| CountryId | CountryName |
|---|---|
| 1 | usa |
| 2 | germany |
| 4 | japan |
| 5 | italy |

I read "produce fiat model" as a country with a car maker that has a model named `fiat` in `model_list`. I combined the two conditions with a UNION, so a country meeting both appears once. I didn't check which condition each country met.
